objective: Guide an operator through comparing the confirmed IDB DCC handoff packet to the Demo Command Center Suitelet and runner preview in sandbox.

steps.step: Open the Demo Command Center Suitelet in sandbox.
steps.expected: Operator is in sandbox DCC surface, not an IDB-triggered SuiteScript flow.
steps.evidence: Screenshot of Suitelet URL/header with sandbox context.

steps.step: Compare Suitelet form fields to handoff suiteletEntryPayload.
steps.expected: Prospect, website, notes, create-new-hero, manufacturing, WIP, eval mode, and action mode match the packet.
steps.evidence: Screenshot or notes showing field-by-field parity.

steps.expected: Subsidiary, location, runner script/deploy IDs, CSV mapping/folder, SO saved search, and WO saved search remain DCC deployment/config values.
steps.evidence: Operator checklist marking DCC config present; no IDB-provided account config IDs.

steps.expected: Runner preview maps prospect, website, notes, generated agenda/extid placeholders, mapping/folder/subsidiary placeholders, location, WIP/MFG flags, hero mode, hero item placeholder, and WC search.
steps.evidence: Screenshot or copied preview showing scheduled runner params.

steps.expected: This smoke stops before DCC submit/queue. No IDB code calls SuiteScript and no runner task is created by IDB.
steps.evidence: No task ID, no submit click, no newly created transaction from this smoke.

steps.expected: DCC remains responsible for item names, assemblies, BOMs, locations, planning controls, routing/WIP, and CSV/Sales Order mechanics.
steps.evidence: Operator notes confirming DCC mechanics are unchanged and not duplicated inside IDB.

steps.expected: Operator marks go only if params are clear, config readiness is understood, and the process remains manual/review-only.
steps.evidence: Completed go/no-go checklist and any screenshots.
